claims.text: A clinician note records that TSH remains high and that levothyroxine is to be increased to 75 mcg daily from Monday.

citations.quote: TSH remains high. Increase levothyroxine 75 mcg daily from Monday.

claims.text: A staff note lists the medication list as including levothyroxine 50 mcg each morning.

citations.quote: Medication list includes levothyroxine 50 mcg each morning.

claims.text: The record contains a conflicting dose fact for levothyroxine: 50 mcg in the medication list versus 75 mcg in the clinician note; the conflict is not reconciled in these entries.

open_questions: Was the levothyroxine dose increase to 75 mcg daily reconciled with the medication list recording 50 mcg each morning?
When was levothyroxine first recorded, and at what dose? The provided entries do not answer this.
What earlier TSH results prompted the levothyroxine dose changes? No prior TSH values are in the record.
Have there been any prior dose adjustments or missed doses of levothyroxine? None are documented in the provided entries.
Is there earlier documentation of a hypothyroidism diagnosis or thyroid history? None appears in the provided entries.
No allergies or reactions are recorded in the provided entries.
No follow-ups, referrals or tests are recorded as planned or outstanding in the provided entries.

candidate_highlights.risk_reason: Levothyroxine dose conflict: clinician note states 75 mcg daily while the medication list records 50 mcg each morning.
candidate_highlights.suggested_action: Review the levothyroxine dosing in the record and confirm which dose is current and whether the medication list was updated.
